walls.note: South (upstream) face from the boat panorama, rectified at 20 px/m (artifacts/bridges/BRU0242/photo-p.jpg).

items.where: two white balance-beam frames (hameien) on the portal posts, sloping up over the leaf tips, cross-braced, the counterweight box at the outer end over the fixed span
items.how: builder: two sloped white beams per leaf with a dark top edge, four cross beams, a dark counterweight box

items.where: two white timber portals: posts beside the narrow deck, an arched crossbeam and a top beam
items.how: builder: square posts, segmental arch of beam segments, top beam and corbels

items.where: dark iron rods from the beams down to the leaf tips and middles; diagonal struts from the posts down to the fixed span
items.how: builder: thin dark bars, three per beam side, one strut per post

items.where: eight segmental arches in the white fixed spans (four each side of the bascule) with pilaster piers; the ninth passage is the bascule opening
items.how: builder: segmental spandrel walls, ring band 6 cm proud, pilasters 15 cm proud, barrel soffits

items.where: white lattice railing on the two leaves
items.how: builder: white posts, top rail and X lattice per bay

items.where: dark iron railing along the fixed spans
items.how: builder: posts every 1.8 m, three rails and bars every 0.3 m following the deck

items.where: replica Jan van der Heyden lantern posts with two lanterns near each bank
items.how: builder: dark lathe post, cross arm, two ochre lantern boxes with dark caps

items.where: red bridge signals and barrier boxes at the leaf ends
items.how: builder: dark posts with a red lamp, dark barrier boxes

items.where: dark tarred timber bascule piers with fender piles flanking the opening
items.how: builder: dark pier block and three dark piles each side

items.where: strings of small LED bulbs outlining the arches, beams and portals (1,800 bulbs, lit at night)

skip.note: individual bulbs are a few centimetres; unlit by day, not readable from the ride

items.where: bridge-keeper hut

skip.note: no hut on the bridge in the panoramas or the Commons photographs; the bridge is operated remotely since 1994
